nodes.label: GLUE: how it works now
nodes.rationale: Central reference for GLUE's architecture: the website, GLUE folder, GLUE Home (Tauri tray app), and GLUE Cloud. Describes how profiles, collections, analysis, DJ libraries, and synchronization work. Updated when architecture changes.

nodes.label: Engine DJ library synchronization
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home keeps Engine DJ's playlists, cues, grids, and drive folder structure in step with GLUE's library through a series of interrelated mechanisms: dj.rs reads and follows libraries, djsync.rs merges changes three ways, djdrives.rs manages the Collection and drive copies, djmirror.rs keeps GLUE playlists in Engine DJ's GLUE folder.
